historical_coverage: SBIR/STTR awards from the programme start (1983) to present
known_limitations: every probed request returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, including a browser-style fetch, while the official /api page carried a maintenance notice on 2026-11-09: the documented API is currently refusing anonymous service
no explicit award-number field; agency_tracking_number/contract/award_link are the only identifiers
no separate publication date for the record, so a public-visibility clock would have to fall back to proposal_award_date
rate_limits: 100 rows per request by default, offset pagination via start=; no published rate limit
research_value: Would add small-business R&D awards adjacent to the five firms' supply chains, but it is currently unusable; recorded as a negative result so a future re-probe can retry rather than rediscover.
